title.zh: Web Fetch 公开评测集选型与执行合同
title.en: Public Web Fetch Benchmark Selection and Execution Contract

decision.summary_zh: 本轮采用 WebMainBench-545 中预先选定的 200 页。它公开了冻结 HTML、人工校准的 Markdown 答案和可运行的评分器；文本、代码、公式和表格可以分别计分。论文与其他开源项目的使用也有来源可核对。
decision.summary_en: This run uses 200 pages preselected from WebMainBench-545. It publishes frozen HTML, human-calibrated Markdown references and a runnable scorer, with separate scores for text, code, formulas and tables. The paper and use in other open-source projects have checkable sources.
decision.qualification_zh: 这里只测预先选定的 200 页，不是官方 545 页工具链总榜，也不是论文的 7,809 页主榜。每页名单和选取方法见上方。
decision.qualification_en: This run measures only the preselected 200 pages, not the official 545-page toolkit leaderboard or the paper's 7,809-page main leaderboard. The page list and selection method are given above.

selection_rules.rule: Prefer reproducible runs and named integrations over mentions, stars or search counts.
selection_rules.rule_zh: 真实运行和具名集成高于提及、Star 或搜索条数。

selection_rules.rule: Reject archived or irreproducible candidates; record the latest push and release rather than assuming age means abandonment.
selection_rules.rule_zh: 排除已归档或不可复现候选；记录最新提交和发布，不能仅凭年份判断废弃。

selection_rules.rule: Prefer human-calibrated structured answers and deterministic scoring; disclose scorer blind spots and optional model dependencies.
selection_rules.rule_zh: 优先人工校准、保留结构的答案和确定性评分；披露评分盲点与可选模型依赖。

selection_rules.rule: The public suite must add extraction fidelity without replacing the existing live-URL access, resource and latency suite.
selection_rules.rule_zh: 公开集应补充抽取保真度，不能替代现有真实 URL 访问、资源与时延评测。

direct_benchmarks.name: WebMainBench-545
direct_benchmarks.scope: fine-grained Markdown fidelity from frozen HTML
direct_benchmarks.scope_zh: 从冻结 HTML 评估细粒度 Markdown 保真度
direct_benchmarks.metric: text, code, formula and table edit similarity plus table TEDS; overall is the arithmetic mean of five independently aggregated component means
direct_benchmarks.metric_zh: 文本、代码、公式、表格编辑相似度及表格 TEDS；overall 是五个分别聚合后的分项均值的算术平均
direct_benchmarks.aggregation: official 545 toolkit over the complete declared subset; publish every component and valid denominator
direct_benchmarks.aggregation_zh: 官方 545 工具链评估完整声明子集；公布每个分项及有效分母
direct_benchmarks.disposition: Selected for this run: published human references and five reproducible component metrics
direct_benchmarks.disposition_zh: 本轮采用；公开人工答案和五项可重算指标
direct_benchmarks.maturity: KDD 2026 paper; repository updated 2026-06-13; v1.0.0 release; multiple independent integrations
direct_benchmarks.maturity_zh: KDD 2026 论文；仓库更新于 2026-06-13；v1.0.0 发布；多个独立项目集成
direct_benchmarks.standard_answer: manually calibrated groundtruth_content Markdown, plus full HTML, selected main HTML and canonical converted Markdown
direct_benchmarks.standard_answer_zh: 人工校准 groundtruth_content Markdown，并保留完整 HTML、选中主 HTML 与规范化转换 Markdown
declared_but_unavailable_categories: style (null in all 545 rows; README schema differs from the released data)

adoption_snapshot.note: Exact-code hits include first-party files and mentions; named integrations were inspected separately.
adoption_snapshot.note_zh: 精确代码搜索包含第一方文件和仅提及；具名集成另行实查。

scorer_audit: The full-set paper metric is ROUGE-5 F1 after html2text and jieba.
The 545 toolkit adds character edit similarity for text/code/formula/table and TEDS for table structure.
Optional LLM splitting changes preprocessing and needs a frozen model, prompt and cache.
Official overall excludes failed component calculations, so component denominators must be published.

Released data differs from the README schema: style is null on 545/545 rows, language on 94/545, main_html is empty on 445/545 and convert_main_content on 200/545; groundtruth_content and html are non-empty on all 545.
scorer_audit_zh: 全量论文指标是在 html2text 与 jieba 后计算 ROUGE-5 F1。
545 工具链增加文本/代码/公式/表格字符编辑相似度和表格结构 TEDS。
可选 LLM 切分会改变预处理，必须冻结模型、提示词和缓存。
官方 overall 排除计算失败的分项，因此必须公布各分项分母。
发布数据与 README 模式不一致：545/545 的 style 为空、94/545 的 language 为空、445/545 的 main_html 为空、200/545 的 convert_main_content 为空；但 545 例的 groundtruth_content 与 html 均非空。

direct_benchmarks.name: WebMainBench v1.1 (full)
direct_benchmarks.scope_zh: 从冻结 HTML 抽取主内容
direct_benchmarks.metric: ROUGE-5 F1 after html2text and jieba
direct_benchmarks.metric_zh: 经 html2text 与 jieba 后计算 ROUGE-5 F1
direct_benchmarks.aggregation: published overall and difficulty macro means
direct_benchmarks.aggregation_zh: 论文公布总体与难度宏平均
direct_benchmarks.disposition: NOT SELECTED — a useful future full regression, but 1.35 GB / 7,809 cases is excessive for the first run and its Markdown target is not manually calibrated per page
direct_benchmarks.disposition_zh: 未选——适合后续全量回归，但首轮没必要承担 1.35 GB / 7,809 例成本，且逐页 Markdown 目标不是人工校准
direct_benchmarks.maturity: same KDD 2026 project and maintenance line as the 545 subset
direct_benchmarks.maturity_zh: 与 545 子集同属 KDD 2026 项目和维护线

direct_benchmarks.name: WCXB v1.0
direct_benchmarks.scope: modern main-content extraction across seven page types
direct_benchmarks.scope_zh: 七种页面类型的现代网页主内容抽取
direct_benchmarks.metric: macro per-page bag-of-words precision, recall and F1; include/exclude hit rates; page-type slices
direct_benchmarks.metric_zh: 逐页词袋精确率、召回率和 F1 的宏平均；应包含/应排除命中率；页面类型切片
direct_benchmarks.aggregation: official evaluate.py over a declared split; missing predictions become empty
direct_benchmarks.aggregation_zh: 官方 evaluate.py 评估声明 split；缺失预测按空输出处理
direct_benchmarks.disposition: RESERVE — borrow its page taxonomy and include/exclude snippets, but do not use it as the sole credibility anchor
direct_benchmarks.disposition_zh: 保留——借鉴页面分类与应包含/应排除片段，但不作为唯一可信度锚点
direct_benchmarks.maturity: new single-author 2026 preprint; no commits after the v1.0 release batch as of 2026-09-14; early adoption
direct_benchmarks.maturity_zh: 2026 年新单作者预印本；截至 2026-09-14，v1.0 发布批次后无新提交；已有早期采用
limitations: The scorer ignores order and Markdown structure; reordered content can retain a perfect score.
Twenty-seven ground truths have empty main_content; empty output receives a perfect score on them.
Audit found 57 required snippets absent from main_content and 41 forbidden snippets present in it.
README documents an --extractor option that evaluate.py does not implement.
The only committed test result contains 5 of 511 rows and its nested format is not accepted by evaluate.py.
limitations_zh: 评分器忽略顺序和 Markdown 结构，打乱内容仍可能满分。
27 份标准答案的 main_content 为空，空输出可得满分。
审计发现 57 个应包含片段不在正文中，41 个应排除片段反而在正文中。
README 记录了 evaluate.py 实际未实现的 --extractor 参数。
唯一提交的 test 结果只含 511 例中的 5 例，且其嵌套格式不能被 evaluate.py 读取。

direct_benchmarks.name: Web Content Extraction Benchmark (WCEB)
direct_benchmarks.scope: main-content extraction from eight frozen legacy corpora
direct_benchmarks.scope_zh: 从八个冻结历史语料库抽取主内容
direct_benchmarks.metric: ROUGE-LSum precision/recall/F1 and normalized token Levenshtein ratio
direct_benchmarks.metric_zh: ROUGE-LSum 精确率/召回率/F1 及归一化 token Levenshtein 比率
direct_benchmarks.aggregation: official macro mean/median and micro aggregates by corpus and overall
direct_benchmarks.aggregation_zh: 官方宏平均/中位数和微聚合，按语料库及总体报告
direct_benchmarks.disposition: NOT SELECTED — strongest historical academic adoption, but older article-heavy text targets are less aligned with modern Markdown fidelity
direct_benchmarks.disposition_zh: 未选——历史学术采用最强，但较旧、偏文章的纯文本目标不够贴合现代 Markdown 保真度
direct_benchmarks.maturity: SIGIR 2023; 11 OpenAlex citations observed 2026-09-14; repository updated 2025-12-16
direct_benchmarks.maturity_zh: SIGIR 2023；2026-09-14 OpenAlex 观测 11 次引用；仓库更新于 2025-12-16

current_benchmark.name: Current Web Fetch live suite
current_benchmark.measures: live URL access, rendering, dynamic pages, structured popular-site output, documents/media/resources, acceptance, fidelity and latency
current_benchmark.measures_zh: 真实 URL 访问、渲染、动态页面、热门站点结构化输出、文档/媒体/资源、验收、保真与时延
current_benchmark.difference: WebMainBench freezes HTML and isolates extraction/conversion; the current suite exercises the end-to-end URL-to-output route and remains necessary.
current_benchmark.difference_zh: WebMainBench 冻结 HTML、隔离抽取/转换；现有套件测端到端 URL 到输出链路，仍不可替代。

fusion_plan.keep: Keep all five WebMainBench-545 components and official overall with frozen conversion and splitting.
fusion_plan.keep_zh: 保留 WebMainBench-545 五个分项与官方 overall，冻结转换和切分。

fusion_plan.keep: Reuse the current one-result predicate, pass/fail filters, failure classes, missing-output denominator and independent review as separate diagnostics.
fusion_plan.keep_zh: 复用现有统一结果判定、通过/失败筛选、失败分类、缺失输出分母和独立复核，作为独立诊断。

fusion_plan.keep: Add current full-body P/R/F1, region coverage and forbidden/error-page checks; borrow WCXB include/exclude snippets only after validating them against the answer.
fusion_plan.keep_zh: 增加现有完整正文 P/R/F1、分区覆盖和禁入/错误页检查；WCXB 的应包含/应排除片段须先与答案交叉校验。

fusion_plan.keep: Keep live success and latency in the 150-case suite. Serve identical frozen HTML bytes to URL-only methods and label that latency as fixture-route latency.
fusion_plan.keep_zh: 真实成功率和时延留在 150 例；对仅支持 URL 的方法提供相同冻结 HTML，并把时延标为夹具链路时延。

sampling_contract.algorithm: greedy coverage of every observed marginal official category, then SHA-256 order fill
sampling_contract.reason: Cover every official category represented in the parent while bounding provider calls; publish parent and sample distributions so rare slices are not over-interpreted.
sampling_contract.reason_zh: 覆盖母集中出现的每个官方分类并限制供应商调用量；公布母集与样本分布，避免过度解读稀有切片。
sampling_contract.status: current formal sample; frozen before provider calls

embedded_or_supplementary.name: CleanEval
embedded_or_supplementary.disposition: Do not score twice: its 738 pages are already in WCEB.
embedded_or_supplementary.disposition_zh: 不重复计分：738 页已包含在 WCEB 中。

embedded_or_supplementary.name: Scrapinghub Article Extraction Benchmark
embedded_or_supplementary.disposition: Do not score twice: its 181 pages are in WCEB; the standalone repository is archived.
embedded_or_supplementary.disposition_zh: 不重复计分：181 页已包含在 WCEB；独立仓库已归档。

adoption_snapshot.warning: Stars, forks and exact-code search counts are context, not user counts or proof of execution. Named runs and integrations are evaluated separately.
adoption_snapshot.warning_zh: Star、Fork 和精确代码搜索条数只是背景，不是用户数，也不证明实际运行；具名运行与集成另行判断。

next_run_contract: Freeze the WebMainBench-545 file hash, scorer commit, package versions and license before calls.
Run every case in the frozen 200-page manifest for every method; extraction failures remain visible and are aggregated exactly as the official evaluator handles failed samples.
Use the official five metrics; default optional LLM splitting off unless its full model/prompt/cache contract is predeclared.
Label the 545-toolkit result as distinct from the paper's 7,809-page ROUGE-5 leaderboard.
Serve identical frozen HTML bytes to URL-only methods; do not fetch current live URLs against frozen answers.
Keep this extraction suite and the current 150-case live suite separate; never create a synthetic combined rank.
Preserve failed calls and declared retries; do not select the best retry.
Publish only after every method has all 200 preselected cases and independent review is resolved.
next_run_contract_zh: 调用前冻结 WebMainBench-545 文件哈希、评分器提交、软件版本和许可证。
每个方法运行冻结清单中的全部 200 例；抽取失败保持可见，并严格按官方 evaluator 对失败样例的方式聚合。
使用官方五项指标；默认关闭可选 LLM 切分，除非预先声明完整模型/提示词/缓存合同。
明确 545 工具链结果不同于论文 7,809 页 ROUGE-5 主榜。
对仅支持 URL 的方法提供相同冻结 HTML；不能拿冻结答案评当前在线 URL。
公开抽取套件与现有 150 例在线套件分开，不创造综合排名。
保留失败调用和声明重试；不挑选最优重试。
所有方法覆盖预选的 200 例且独立复核完成后才发布。
